chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari narrated to me from his father, from 'Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from 'Abdillah ibn Hammad Al-Basri, from 'Abdillah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman Al-Asam, from 'Abdillah ibn Muskān, who said:

I saw Abā 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him) when a group of people from Khurāsān had come to visit him. They asked him about going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (peace be upon him) and its rewards. He said: My father (peace be upon him) narrated to me that my grandfather (peace be upon him) used to say: Whoever visits him seeking the Face of Allah, Allah will remove his sins as He removes the sins of a newborn whom its mother gave birth to. Angels will accompany him on his journey, flapping their wings over his head, having lined up their wings over him, until he returns to his family. The angels will seek forgiveness for him from his Lord, and Mercy will cover him from the highest part of the sky. The angels will call out to him, 'You have been blessed and blessed is the one to whose Ziyārah you have come,' and his family will be protected for him.

key_terms.إِتْيَانِ قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: Going to the grave of Husain

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards and blessings for visiting the grave of Imam Husain (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith highlights the theological significance of Ziyārah to Imam Ḥusain (a.s.) as a means of spiritual purification, linking the visitor’s sincerity to the removal of sins akin to a newborn. It further emphasizes the cosmic dimension of this act, where angels escort the pilgrim and invoke divine mercy, reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory and protective power of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from his father, from ‘Ali ibn Muḥammad ibn Sālim, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Ḥammād Al-Basri, from ‘Abdillāh ibn ‘Abdil Raḥmān Al-Asam, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Muskān, who said:

I saw Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) when a group of people from Khurāsān had come to visit him. They asked him about going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.) and its rewards. Imam (a.s.) said: My father (a.s.) narrated to me that my grandfather (Imam Sajjād (a.s.)) used to say: Allāh will erase the sins of those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) for the sake of (pleasing) Allāh. They will be sinless like a newborn baby. Angels will accompany them on their way (to the Ziyārah) and they will flap and spread their wings over them until they return to their families. Angels will seek forgiveness for them from their Lord and call out to them, “You have been blessed and blessed is the one to whose Ziyārah you have come.” They will be covered by Mercy from the heavens and their families will be protected for them.
